description: Canadian Urban Data Catalogue is an external data catalogue linking to multiple resources. This record describes the catalogue inventory, not a single dataset. Saved infrastructure members include Alberta oil-sands regulatory operating-capacity data; 2006 Commercial Vehicle Survey: traffic volumes at survey stations; Blood Indian Creek Reservoir bathymetry, contours and boundary. The catalogue publisher identity is not established separately in this link record. The catalogue link comes from saved parent-discovery metadata and its exact seed-to-parent evidence. Coverage here is limited to the individually listed infrastructure resources; the external inventory can also contain other subjects or resource types. Access is through the public catalogue page recorded below. Member formats, licence terms, cost and access requirements vary and must be checked on each source record; no catalogue-wide permission is inferred. The catalogue supports discovery of inputs for infrastructure simulation where individual member metadata establishes that role. Related records are existing members, not an exhaustive inventory. Caveats: no fresh source visit was made for this addition. Current links, historical versions and complete member coverage remain unverified. No dataset files were downloaded.
